correctness.rationale: Design 2-frame and centering define a complementary rank-two projection with equal diagonal, inducing six unit complex roots whose first two power sums vanish; self-reciprocal polynomial z6-c z3+d forces two triples of roots and hence two orthonormal original triples with relative twist. Cauchy formula B(v)=pi/3 sum |xi·v| and the exact spherical covariance E|x·V||y·V|=2H(x·y)/(3pi) give the stated variance with correct six within and nine cross pairs. Squared cross-dot products sum to one and strictly majorize along twist, while h(s)=H(sqrt s) is strictly convex; Karamata yields continuum monotonicity and endpoint uniqueness. Independent endpoint and 200-angle checks corroborate but do not prove the continuum.
